title: services.packages.update
description: Payload of commands/package_update.sql (header only — the lines are not editable through this door). Full snapshot; PARTIAL for callers via `records.package.patch` (hub#632): the runtime reads `services.packages.get` with `package_id` and completes the omitted keys before validating. Explicit `null` clears (`fixed_price: null` removes the closed price); omitted preserves. Closed contract (services#9).

package_id.description: Id of the package to update, of this hub.

slug.description: URL-safe key, unique per hub: lowercase, no spaces.

discount_type.description: Discriminator of the typed discount (migration 004): `percentage` reads `discount_percent`, `fixed` reads `discount_amount_cents`.

discount_percent_bp.description: Percent off when `discount_type = percentage`, as an INTEGER of BASIS POINTS (1050 = 10,50 %; 0..10000). It is not a `number` on purpose: the runtime types a bind from the value, so a `number` reaches the same statement as int8 or float8 depending on the payload, and the cached statement reads the bytes as whichever came first (services#55). Basis points keep the two decimals and have ONE shape on the wire.

fixed_price.description: Closed price of the whole package in minor units, or null (price = sum of lines minus discount).

validity_days.description: Days the voucher stays redeemable after its first use; null = never expires.

max_uses.description: Uses the voucher grants; null = unlimited.
